component.name: ImageMagick
component.summary: Create, convert and edit images from the command line

description.p: ImageMagick creates, converts and edits images in many formats. Use its command-line tools for image processing and automation. This portable build has no X11 display or animate support.

This community package repackages the official upstream build unmodified. Run commands with flatpak run org.imagemagick.ImageMagick. The application menu opens a terminal that prompts for input and output image paths and remains open between conversions; press Enter at the input prompt to close it. Files in your home folder are accessible; paths may be relative to your home folder or absolute.

External drives are not included: run flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media org.imagemagick.ImageMagick to add them. Undo overrides with flatpak override --user --reset org.imagemagick.ImageMagick.
